definitions.gloss: to broadcast live, to relay (a broadcast)
definitions.explanation: To transmit a live event via television, radio, or the internet to viewers or listeners.
To receive something and pass it on to the next point, such as a signal or communication.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}を{生|なま}{中継|ちゅうけい}する。
そのコンサートはテレビで{全国|ぜんこく}に{中継|ちゅうけい}された。
examples.english: The concert was broadcast nationwide on television.

examples.japanese: {開会式|かいかいしき}の{模様|もよう}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}に{衛星|えいせい}{中継|ちゅうけい}されていた。
examples.english: The opening ceremony was being broadcast via satellite around the world.

examples.japanese: {信号|しんごう}を{中継|ちゅうけい}する。
この{基地局|きちきょく}は{電波|でんぱ}を{中継|ちゅうけい}する{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たしている。
examples.english: This base station serves the role of relaying radio waves.

examples.japanese: {人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}が{地上|ちじょう}からの{通信|つうしん}を{中継|ちゅうけい}して、{遠|とお}く{離|はな}れた{地域|ちいき}にも{届|とど}ける。
examples.english: Satellites relay communications from the ground and deliver them to distant regions.

notes:
A compound of {中|ちゅう} (middle) and {継|けい} (relay, succeed). The noun form {中継|ちゅうけい} is very commonly used on its own, especially in the phrase {生中継|なまちゅうけい} (live broadcast).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|なま}{中継|ちゅうけい}: live broadcast
- {衛星|えいせい}{中継|ちゅうけい}: satellite relay/broadcast
- {中継|ちゅうけい}{地点|ちてん}: relay point
- {中継|ちゅうけい}{局|きょく}: relay station

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {放送|ほうそう}する: to broadcast — general term for any broadcast, not necessarily live
- {配信|はいしん}する: to stream, to distribute — commonly used for internet streaming
